notes.title: Important Update Regarding Sound Assets
notes.notes:
Hello all,

Unfortunately, we received a cease-and-desist notice from Garage Software, inc. for using sound assets from their 'Band' software without their permission. Thus, in this update, we have hastily replaced all the musical instruments in the game's soundtrack with versions that the developer and some of his friends hastily recorded at 4 am.

We apologize for this sudden change, and will be working to further refine the music and sounds of Tanks in the coming weeks. For more information about this change, please check out our blog post here: [url=https://tinyurl.com/tanks-sounds-updates]https://tanks-thecrusades.com/tanks-sounds-updates[/url]

Update: this was an April Fools joke, and the sounds are back to normal. But if you liked the sounds, you can still use them! Download the sound pack [url=https://1drv.ms/u/s!AnwBrt306BrJgrhJ5UapEo8VAyHfHA?e=MqXNaf]here[/url] and extract the contents to the ~/.tanks/resources folder, such that the "music" and "sound" folders are in there. If the resources folder doesn't exist, make it yourself!

notes.title: Tanks v1.4, the tank editor update - developer progress video
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

So it's been a while since the last update, and I didn't want to leave you all in the dark about the future of the game. I'm still alive and working on the game! The next update, Tanks v1.4, is coming soon, and will bring the highly anticipated ability to make custom tanks with an all-new tank editor. You'll be able to change over 50 options for each tank to create your own tanks, and use these tanks in your levels and crusades! I'm also adding some new other features, like the light blue tank which blows wind, and the salmon tank which launches homing bullets. If you want to see all of these in action and get more information, go check out the video below!

[previewyoutube=xht-0XOhw7g;full][/previewyoutube]

And version 1.4 is not where the fun ends. There are more planned features on the list for after 1.4, like first person view, Steam Workshop support, collaborative level editing, and better custom bullets. 

Until the next one,
-aehmttw

notes.title: Steam Networking Performance Bugfix
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I have received reports over the last few weeks of Tanks performing rather poorly in multiplayer while over Steam peer-to-peer. Upon further investigation, I discovered a bug with the packet buffering which was causing packets to not be sent when they should have been sent, and instead waiting a bit longer. This bug was first introduced somewhere around v1.3.1, in an attempt to improve network performance. I've hopefully fixed the bug, and uploaded a new version of the game to Steam. If you still have issues with playing multiplayer, please let me know.

I'm sorry it took so long to get this fix out, I have been quite busy lately. But my summer is coming soon, so I'll have more time to develop the game! Update 1.4 is in development right now, and I hope you will like the new editor features and tanks it will bring :)

notes.title: Mac launch issues bugfix
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Some people were reporting the game not launching on Mac OS after the last update, 1.3.0. I've pushed an update to the Mac build of the game so that the game will now run as expected. No other changes were made to the game itself.

I'm sorry for any inconveniences this bug may have caused.

notes.title: Windows launch issues bugfix
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I've been hearing reports from numerous Windows users that Tanks was not launching. I've pushed an update to the Windows version of the game that changes how the game is launched which should hopefully fix these issues. From a small number of reports, it seems this update has solved the issue with launching on Steam, but if you are still encountering problems (or if the game will no longer launch anymore for you), please let me know!

An added bonus is that with this minor update, Tanks extensions (mods) will now load properly on the Steam version of the game (at least for Windows), no more need to manually launch the JAR!

Other than that, there are no new features to the game itself. But be on the lookout for Update 1.2.2 which will be coming soon, bringing an all-new stats screen when you finish a crusade :)

Thank you for playing Tanks!

notes.title: Tanks: The Crusades - Release Party and Stream
notes.notes:
Want to play Tanks with the developer himself? Or just watch the developer miserably fail at his own game? Join the stream now!

If you'd like to join the party and actually play with us, install Tanks: The Crusades, pick a username in multiplayer options, then go to Play -> Multiplayer -> Join a Party and in the "Party IP Address" type in "[b]matei.ga:8080[/b]" (without quotes). Then click join, and you'll be in!

This event starts on June 24th, 2021 at 2:00pm, Los Angeles time.
